model_annotation: The pie chart represents the integration of design in the product development process within an organization. There are five categories depicted in the chart. The largest segment, colored green, represents "Good is integrated" and accounts for 25% of the chart. The second largest segment, colored orange, represents "Somewhat good is integrated" and makes up 24% of the chart. The third segment, colored purple, represents "Not integrated at all" and constitutes 20% of the chart. The fourth segment, colored red, represents "Not integrated at all" and accounts for 8% of the chart. The smallest segment, colored blue, represents "Not integrated at all" and makes up 10% of the chart. The chart does not include a legend, percentage labels inside the slices, or any slices that are visually emphasized. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest segment at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
